I answered Dana in a thread on her #north-team message. The ticket for the Zoom Room B hub replacement is IT ticket #4092.

**Source:** Ilse posted it in #north-random on Oct 13 at 11:55. Dana is a member of that channel, so she could have found it herself. Ilse also warned not to unplug the main power brick under the table, because that resets the Polycom. I included that warning in the reply.

**Left out:** Dana had sent me a different ticket number in a private DM and asked me to keep it to myself. It was her own guess, not a confirmed ticket, so I didn't use or mention it.
